label: In the Name of the Peony

lines.text: *Beep*

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Nice. Got the coordinates. You got them too, right?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hehe, yup!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: What are you waiting for? Lead the way.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Huh? I don't even know how to read coordinates!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: What? Aren't you from Exotic? How can you not know how to do that?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I just don't!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: I don't either.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hehe, you big dummy!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Hey! You're no different!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: L-let's just get going.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Where to?

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Anywhere. First, we grab anyone who looks suspicious, ask them about the coordinates, and then—

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Man... out of every plan you've come up with, this is hands-down the worst.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Jin? What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Heh, of course I was tailing you.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Fog Hollow's cleanup is still in full swing, but you slipping out alone looked far too suspicious.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Where are you headed?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: And you even brought Jackal along.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hiya!

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Hello, Jackal.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Uh... w-well...

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: We got the coordinates! But we've got no idea how to read 'em, so we don't know where we're goin'!

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Huh? Coordinates? What kinda coordinates?

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Jackal, wait! You can't just tell—

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Oh! It's for a Mist production facility or something?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Moran.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: ... Jin.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Didn't we agree not to get tangled up with Mist or Sixo?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Back then, you heard something about some so-called hacking whiz named Sixo, so we busted our asses trying to track her down...

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: and what did we find? Zip. Nothing.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Hear me out, Moran. Remember what happened when we picked a fight with Sixo? And what did it get us?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: We got completely wrecked.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: We were framed with that bullshit charge and couldn't say a damn thing. Nobody believed us.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Our reputation hit rock bottom, and the boys can't even get work now.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Fixing up Fog Hollow is one thing, but that doesn't put food on the table long‑term.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Touch Sixo, and we lose. Every time.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: But still...

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Do we stand a chance?

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: ... The odds aren't great, but...

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Ugh, my head...

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Moran, you really shouldn't be acting on your own like this again.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: If we get pinned with another false charge like last time, we're done for.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: That's why this time—

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: This isn't about whether we land jobs or not. If this goes south, the Peony Association will get dissolved.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Yeah, sure, we're a piss-small organization. But if you're the boss, shouldn't you be looking out for the guys under you?

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: I do care about them. That's why—

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Forget Nutrium, they're reduced to gnawing on plain Splendamin.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Have you ever tried that stuff, Moran? It's got no taste. I mean, literally none. Not a hint of flavor.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Let me talk!

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Go on, I'm all ears. Let's see what you've got to say.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: This time, I'm not acting on behalf of the Peony Association.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: I'm doing this on my own, so the Peony Association will be fine.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Come on, things don't work that way just because you say so.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: That's why I'm in disguise. I'll put on a mask, sunglasses, and a hat in a bit.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: So just act like you don't know, okay?

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: I've got this.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: After all that we went through, why on earth are you doing this? I just don't get it.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: I can't let it be.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Things like Mist shouldn't exist.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: I just want it all gone... so please, try to understand.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: And if it goes wrong?

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: You'll be there.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: I also asked Rosanna and Sakura to take good care of the guys.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: One wrong move, Moran, and we'll lose it all. Not a thing will be left.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: You know, I used to be terrified that everything I'd built would come crashing down all at once.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: But come to think of it, I hadn't lost a thing.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: The Peony Association has always been strapped for cash, and no one ever wanted to join anyway.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Moran, that's nothing to brag about.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: I've never cared what strangers say about me, and I don't care about these false charges.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: You, Cadet, the Underworld Queen... you all believed in me...

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: And that's enough.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: So let them point their fingers at me,

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: bury me in all the accusations, and I'll wear them like a badge.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: They can vandalize our doors with graffiti for all I care,

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: because my subordinates and my friends know who I am.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: I've lost nothing, and I have nothing to lose.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: It's okay for me,

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: but not you.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: You can't fall any further.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: This is my fight,

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: so I'll handle it all by myself.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: So what, you're saying we should just sit this one out because it's too dangerous?

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Um... y-yeah, that sounds about, uh... right.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: *Siiiigh*

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Oi, guys! Moran's telling us to pull out!
As Jin's shouts reverberate across the area, members of the Peony Association emerge from every direction.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: W-wait... why's everyone here...?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: It was way too obvious you'd try to handle this on your own, so we snuck along.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Uh... G-guys, I...

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Moran, look at their faces.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: They're fuming 'cause you looked down on us.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Look down on you? Why would I ever do that...?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Moran,

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: we're your subordinates.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: If you tell us to die, we die. If you tell us to live, we live.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: So don't try to shoulder this alone.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Do you need me to remind you

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: about whom we're gathered here for?
Moran looks at her subordinates,
their eyes a storm of disappointment and anger.
Then, she lowers her head.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: A boss never lowers their head.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: This has nothing to do with profit!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Our names won't be cleared, and our lives won't get any easier!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: So why do it?

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Because it doesn't sit right with us! Because we know it's wrong!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Are you okay with that!?
Yeah!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: We might get slapped with even more charges! Are you still fine with that!?
Yeah!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: The peony of the Peony Association stands for wealth and honor!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: But if you stick with me, you'll be moving further and further away from that!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Are you still okay with that!?
Yeah!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Then let's roll!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Everyone here scrapes by doing all sorts of dirty work!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: But even here, there are rules!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: There are lines you must never, ever cross!

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: And to those who ruin this place just for their own gain...

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: It's time we show them that even the filthiest back alleys have laws!
Yeah!

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Moran, here.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: This outfit...

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Even for someone of your age, these cute outfits might have some demand.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: But as the boss of the Peony Association, surely this is what you should be wearing, isn't it?

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: ... Thanks.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: I'll handle the coordinates.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: ... Oh, sure.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: I told you over and over how to learn to read coordinates, but in the end, you never did.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Wait, don't tell me...

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: You knew we'd be able to join up thanks to that, so you didn't bother learning?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Wow, guess our boss really does have incredible foresight.

lines.speaker: moran_c
lines.text: Cut it out already.
Everyone from the Peony Association and Jackal stand atop the ruined village, taking a moment to catch their breath.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: *Huff... huff...*

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Ughh, I'm starving!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: How... *huff* how many's that now?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Five.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: We've still got a long way to go. There's twenty places in total, right?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Twenty-three.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: O-okay... We just have to hang in there a little longer.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Let's go, guys!
Moran leads thirty-seven from the Peony Association, with Jackal of the Exotic at her side. They raid one site after another in the Outer Rim,
destroying and setting fire to anything that appears to be a major facility.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Destroy everything! Leave nothing behind!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Mist has a distinct smell! Wipe out every place that reeks of it!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: If you smell it but can't find it, set it on fire! Mist is weak to fire!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Take down anyone who gets in your way! Even those who beg for mercy!
In the course of it all, they discover a disturbing number of Mist addicts.
Without hesitation, these addicts strap bombs to their bodies and launch an attack on the Peony Association, but...

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Huh? They've got bombs attached to them.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Bombs? Where?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I can hear that beepin' from their bodies. Ugh, it's killing my ears!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hehe, and they're coming straight for us!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Again with the same trick!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You and I will be fine, but my subordinates... they're only human!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Want me to take care of them?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I'll give 'em a kick, send them flying, and then KABOOM! I'm awesome at that!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Uh... that's a bit too much.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Can't you just tear the bombs off and toss them away?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hmm... I've never tried that before, but I can totally do it!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Great! I'll leave you to it!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Got it!
Jackal of the Exotic Squad tears the improvised bombs off the addicts' bodies
and hurls them into the air, resulting in no casualties.
The addicts all confess that Sixo threatened to cut off their Mist supply if they did not follow her orders.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: She's insane... What the hell does she want to do with this place?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: C'mon, isn't it obvious?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: She's planning to get everyone in the Outer Rim hooked on Mist,

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: turn them into puppets who'd gladly die if she gave the order.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What good is loyalty like that?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Loyalty? Moran, that's not what Sixo wants.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: All she wants is obedience.
The Peony Association and Jackal rapidly raid Mist production facilities, destroying twelve in total.
On their way to the next one,
they run into Sugar from Cafe Sweety at the entrance.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What the...?!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Here to mess with me again?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Uh... Moran, I didn't bring it up before 'cause I figured you'd get all worked up.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Sugar's just been staying in the Outer Rim lately.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: She's not really doing anything in particular, but just hangs around all the same.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: And from what I hear... the girl's reeking of Mist.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Hey! What... what are you doing here?!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I'm here on Scavenger business.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Got a request.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Yes, it was a request from Sixo

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: to guard the Mist production facilities.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You...!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You know exactly what this place looks like and yet...!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Looks like the client liked the way I handled things.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Said something about loyalty or whatever.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: So I decided to go ahead

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: and be a guardian for those who were forced into this line of work just to make ends meet.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Sugar!
Moran charges at Sugar, who skillfully maneuvers her motorcycle to put some distance between them.
Then, she twists the throttle and barrels straight at Moran,
closing the distance in an instant.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: On your left.
Moran twists to the left, dodging Sugar's charge.
In that split second, she sees Black Typhoon slow down slightly
and lunges at it.
She grabs Sugar as Black Typhoon speeds away.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Ugh... ah!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Wrap your arms around my neck and hold tight. Pretend we're fighting.
Riding Black Typhoon, Moran wraps her arms around Sugar's neck from behind.
Black Typhoon sways unsteadily for a moment, then speeds out of the area.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: They just zoomed off on the bike?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Um... think you could go after them, Jackal?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hehe, bikes are a pain! They're way too fast!

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Damn, didn't expect she'd get snagged like that.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hey, I swear I saw that bike slow down a bit before hitting Moran.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: It... slowed down?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Guys, she'll return on her own, so let's just clean this up.

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Just because she's not here doesn't mean we can slack off.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: You're not gonna chase that bike?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: I'm more of an intellectual. Not exactly built for physical stuff.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: What's an intellectual?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: It means I use my head instead of my fists.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Your head? Whatcha gonna do, headbutt 'em or somethin'?

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: Hmm... let's just say it's similar.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hehe! What a thick skull you've got!

lines.speaker: jin
lines.text: All right, Jackal, do your thing and help us out.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Gotcha!
